title: CALIDO REVEALED! - Copi Cafe Episode 50 - Cornucopias
description:
Settle in for the most anticipated episode of Copi Cafe ever. Josh Jones and Rob Greig bring us up to date on the development of Cornucopias before taking us on the a tour of a few parts of the Calido Valley Raceway Mega Dome.

DIG IN, and see how many leaks you can see while they run around in Multiplayer mode.  Rob in England, Josh in the US, and running around together, in-game!!!

00:00 - Dedication
00:10 - Beverage Choices
03:27 - AI Integration
04:27 - Cardano Meetup
06:35 - New Discord Channels
08:44 - Community Questions
15:42 - Racing Game Update
22:21 - Testing
28:00 - LEAK!

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
